messages.subject: Data augmentation with TMB?
parts:
Dear TMB users,

 

I am currently fitting state space models using TMB and I would like to know if anyone have already implemented data augmentation in this package.


My data consist of time series of 3 simultaneous types of observations of latent processes (dynamics of experimental populations of microalgae replicated in batch). I would like to fit a state space model on this data set, but many observations are missing:

-  For two observation methods, I cannot get population size estimation when the number of individuals is too low

-  For the last observation method, I got data only half of the time.

I became aware that points in the latent process would not affect equally the likelihood when they do not have the same number of observations, which may be a problem to estimate process parameters.


I would appreciate any suggestions to deal with this problem.


Thanks,


Marie

I have not personally done data augmentation (at least not that I know of). Are you trying to decide how to initialize the true state of your time series?

My data consist of time series of 3 simultaneous types of observations of latent processes (dynamics of experimental populations of microalgae replicated in batch). I would like to fit a state space model on this data set, but many observations are missing:

-  For two observation methods, I cannot get population size estimation when the number of individuals is too low

This is sometimes handled by setting a detection limit. See Cadigan 2014 for an example of this (https://doi.org/10.1139/cjfas-2015-0047). The paragraph at the top right of page 299 of the pdf describes the problem and solution.

cheers,
Mollie
